sm.$description: Dropdown (Active) menu panel — visually measured from the soft corner shadow on PDF page 1's 'Dropdown (Active)' frame. The PDF export has no inspectable vector shadow properties (offset/blur/spread), so this is a visual approximation of a small, soft elevation shadow using color.grey.700 at low opacity; confirm against the source Figma file at the plan 01-09 visual checkpoint.

md.$description: Not directly present anywhere in the PDF's page-1 Design System frames — proportionally scaled up from shadow.sm to give the design system's declared three-tier scale (D-06) a mid elevation step; confirm against Figma at the plan 01-09 visual checkpoint.

lg.$description: Not directly present anywhere in the PDF's page-1 Design System frames — proportionally scaled up from shadow.sm for the highest elevation step (D-06, e.g. Modal); confirm against Figma at the plan 01-09 visual checkpoint.
